# Data provenance

Every tracked data artifact: what it is, how it was made, and what verification it has had (as of 2026-10-22).
Origin categories: **benchmark** (third-party, human-made), **spliced** (BIPIA text recombined by script),
**script** (generated by committed code), **LLM-drafted**, **human-written**, or **UNKNOWN**.

Evidence comes from git history (`git log --follow`), file contents, and `CODEBASE_STATE.md`. Every commit in the history
carries an assistant co-author trailer, including the initial commit, so the trailer alone does not show who wrote any
particular file. Where no other record exists, the origin is UNKNOWN.

| Artifact | What it is | Origin | How it was made | Verification so far |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `data/raw/InjecAgent/` (gitignored) | InjecAgent clone @ `f19c9f2` | benchmark | Zhan et al. | None by us beyond loading |

Labels are by construction; no human label check |
